title: I’m disappointed!
text:
I’m disappointed!. When I take a cold bottle of Crystal Geyser drinking water in my car for a few hours with the air
On this summer in Ca. but leave my car for about 3 hours it’s now warm and yucky.
So I thought this Host Freeze bottle would keep my water ice cold! Wrong!
I did as direction said , turn it up-side down in the freezer so the gel inside would freeze, I did that for 24 hours then Took it out , and put a fresh bottle of Crystal Geyser water 16.9 oz,- 550 mL in this Host frozen bottle.
Btw it would not take the whole 16.9 oz. !!!!
Thinking this host Bottle would be great, Wrong!!! when I got back to my car where this bottle was in between the seats, Covered with sport hat, and covered my front window, the water was just cool, not even cold.
The idea of this should be accurate but it’s not.
It would be Better to buy a good thermos, don’t waste your money on this.
I’m just giving this 2 stars!

features: A WATER BOTTLE THAT KEEPS YOUR WATER COLD - Forget the lukewarm sips from plastic water bottles. The HOST FREEZE Bottle is an insulated water bottle that actively chills water, ice tea, iced coffee, or any of your favorite beverages.

DOUBLE WALLED, INSULATED WITH ACTIVE COOLING GEL - Active cooling gel in the insulated tumbler chills down drinks and keeps them cold. Just place your water bottle upside down in the freezer for 2+ hours to distribute the gel evenly and freeze.

STAINLESS STEEL LID AND SILICONE BAND - This water bottle version of HOST’s cooling cups includes a stainless steel lid to keep it tightly sealed and a silicone band for a firm grip. Holds 20 oz. of your favorite protein shake, smoothie, or juice.

GREAT GIFT FOR ATHLETES, COLLEGE STUDENTS, AND BUSY MOMS - The HOST FREEZE Bottle is perfect for anyone who loves to work out, students, moms and dads, or anyone with a busy schedule. A useful gym gift, birthday gift or back to school gift.

HACK YOUR HOME AND KITCHEN- HOST's beverage accessories are developed through meticulous testing and revision for uniquely functional items. From chilling smoothie tumblers to insulated beer mugs, HOST offers practical, giftable life hacks.
description: Staying hydrated has never been so refreshing. The HOST FREEZE Bottle is designed to keep any beverage deliciously chilled for hours so you can enjoy ice cold drinks wherever you go. The double walled plastic tumbler includes built-in active cooling gel that chills room temperature drinks down quickly or keeps cold liquid frosty and chilled. Perfect for hot days at the beach, the gym, or any time you want refreshingly cool beverages on the go, this 20 oz insulated water bottle with a silicone sleeve and stainless steel lid will be your new favorite travel cup.
